experiment: E007 — Hidden speed (WR): tracked top-end speed beyond the 40 time
written_by: orchestrator, before any agent or person examined the P2/P3 targets against any Combine feature
already_seen_before_this_prereg: E001/E006: Combine 40 peak speed and fitted vmax predict WR regular-season top speed beyond B2 (partial r ~ +0.32..+0.38). P1 below is therefore a replication under harness rev 2 with a new feature definition, NOT independent confirmation.
The choice of a flying split as the feature was informed by an E006 skeptic's post-hoc finding that a tracked flying split (x 31->50) absorbs the vmax signal for game S0.
E006 exploratory: vmax -> WR/TE YAC over expected (null) and deep-route separation at pass_forward (null). These targets are therefore NOT used as primaries.
Target semantics checks only (no Combine association): cushion is recorded on ~95% of WR REG routes (median 6.3 yd); rec_yards is null on routes without a catch (treated as 0 yards).

feature.name: c_flying20
feature.definition: Average speed (yd/s) over yards 20-40 of the 40-yd dash, from tracking: along-track distance from the motion-onset position (not the 'dis' field), interpolated crossing times at 20 and 40 yd, 20 / (t40 - t20). Player value = mean over QC-passing attempts (bdb27.speed, E006 QC rules).
feature.population: Combine position WR with >= 1 QC-passing tracked 40

harness: bdb27.linkage.evaluate, protocol rev 2 (PLAN.md §4): B2 incl. draft-year dummies, expected_sign=+1, n_repeats=50, n_perm=2000, n_perm_fl=10000, seeds 0, 1, 2.

primary_tests.target: game_top_speed: q95 of the player's REG play max speed (bdb27.features.game_top_speed; plays > 12 yd/s dropped; >= 50 REG plays)
primary_tests.rationale: Mechanism: speed the stopwatch hides shows up as higher top-end speed in games. Replication of E001/E006.

primary_tests.target: cushion_oe: per-route defender cushion at the snap (player_play.cushion) minus a cross-fitted (5-fold by game) play-level expectation from context only: lined_up_position, receiver_alignment, offense_formation, in_motion_at_ball_snap, team_coverage_man_zone, down, yards_to_go, yards to the end zone, quarter, score differential, season, and the DEFENSE's team-season. Per-player mean of residuals, shrunk with bdb27.shrinkage.eb_mean (prior estimated on eligible players), >= 50 REG routes with cushion.
primary_tests.rationale: Defenses respect speed: defensive backs play off receivers they fear will run past them.

primary_tests.target: yprr_oe: per-route receiving yards (0 if no catch) minus a cross-fitted play-level expectation from the same context as P2 (no route type: route choice is part of how a player is used), per-player mean, EB-shrunk (bdb27.shrinkage.eb_mean), >= 100 REG routes.
primary_tests.rationale: Performance: hidden speed turns into production per route run.

go: PLAN.md §4 rev 2 criteria for each test, BH across these 3 primaries (and report BH across all E007 tests).
prespecified_robustness_not_additional_c: leave-3-out influence: drop the 3 players with the largest positive contribution to the partial correlation
feature variants: raw tracked peak speed (E001 feature), fitted vmax, flying 10 (yards 30-40)
target variants: P1 with the A-S profile S0 (speed.py draws); P2 with alignment-centered raw cushion; P3 with raw EB-shrunk YPRR
team-share of the P2/P3 targets (reliability.team_share) and split-half reliability
exploratory_prelisted: career outcome: offensive snaps per available season (player_career_successes) beyond B2
